```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
big_tech_stock_prices <- read_csv("big_tech_stock_prices.csv")
theme_set(theme_minimal())
```


```{r}
glimpse(big_tech_stock_prices)
```



```{r}
ggplot(big_tech_stock_prices,
       aes(x = date,
           y = close,
           color = stock_symbol)) +
  geom_line(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~stock_symbol) +
  labs(title = "Big Tech Stock Price Trends",
       x = "Date",
       y = "Closing Price ($)")
```


```{r}
big_tech_stock_prices |> 
  count(stock_symbol, name = "Observations") |> 
  rename(`Stock Symbol` = stock_symbol) |> 
  gt() |> 
  tab_header(title = "Number of Observations")
```




```{r}
annual_returns <- big_tech_stock_prices |> 
  mutate(year = year(date)) |> 
  arrange(date) |> 
  summarise(start_price = first(close),
            end_price = last(close),
            annual_return = ((end_price - start_price) / start_price) * 100,
            .by = c(stock_symbol, year)) |> 
  summarise(avg_annual_return = mean(annual_return),
            .by = year)
```

```{r}
ggplot(annual_returns, 
       aes(x = year, 
           y = avg_annual_return)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(avg_annual_return, 2)), 
            vjust = -.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
             linetype = "dashed",
             color = "red",
             alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Average Annual Return of Big Tech Stocks",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Average Annual Return (%)")
```


```{r}
big_tech_stock_prices |> 
  arrange(date) |> 
  summarise(start_price = first(close),
            end_price = last(close),
            annual_return = round((((end_price - start_price) / start_price) * 100 / 13), 2),
            .by = stock_symbol) |> 
  rename(`Stock Symbol` = stock_symbol,
         `Annual Return (%)` = annual_return) |> 
  arrange(desc(`Annual Return (%)`)) |> 
  gt() |> 
  tab_header(title = "Big Tech Annualized Returns") |> 
  cols_align(align = "center")
```




```{r}
big_tech_stock_prices |> 
  mutate(year = year(date)) |> 
  filter(year == 2022) |> 
  arrange(date) |> 
  summarise(start_price = first(close),
            end_price = last(close),
            total_return = round(((end_price - start_price) / start_price) * 100, 2),
            .by = stock_symbol) |> 
  rename(`Stock Symbol` = stock_symbol,
         `Start Price` = start_price,
         `End Price` = end_price,
         `Total Return (%)` = total_return) |> 
  arrange(desc(`Total Return (%)`)) |> 
  gt() |> 
  tab_header(title = "Total Return by Company (2022)")
```
